title: Confusing Description, Poor Quality, Not What I Expected
text: Confusing Description, Poor Quality, Not What I Expected. The description is incredibly confusing. We thought we were getting a blanket, pillowcases and a fabric panel for the wall.  You actually have to choose if the fabric you get is going to be used as the blanket or hung on the wall -  you don't get both.  The "blanket" is super, super thin material and the quality is not very good either. Save your money and DO NOT buy this.
